echo_sets.name: Heart of Evil's Purge
echo_sets.note: Her dedicated Aero Tune Strain set; the 5-pc bonus provides extra damage stats plus Calamity Effigy's Aero DMG passives when Tune Strain is applied.

echo_sets.name: Sierra Gale
echo_sets.note: General Aero DMG set; boosts Aero DMG after Intro Skill. Weaker than her signature set but usable.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Glint of Clouds (or Red Spring / Emerald of Genesis) + 5-piece Heart of Evil's Purge in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Calamity Effigy in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, one Aero DMG and one ATK% 3-cost, ATK% 1-costs, and 125% Energy Regen.

ranked_weapons.name: Glint of Clouds
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature; provides significant Aero DMG buffs triggered by her Tune Strain with near-permanent uptime. By far her strongest option.

ranked_weapons.name: Red Spring
ranked_weapons.note: High base ATK and Crit Rate with additional ATK passive; strong limited 5-star alternative.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald Sentence
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate and Heavy Attack DMG amplification on Echo Skill; usable alternative.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Standard-banner sword; Crit Rate, Energy Regen, and stackable ATK on Resonance Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Lumingloss
ranked_weapons.note: BP 4-star; ATK% with Heavy Attack DMG on Resonance Skill. Good F2P pick.

ranked_weapons.name: Feather Edge
ranked_weapons.note: BP 4-star; ATK and Crit Rate with ATK and Liberation DMG effect. Usable.

stat_priorities.note: One Aero DMG Bonus and one ATK% piece is recommended with her signature (which has lower ATK); two Aero DMG pieces work without it.

profile.role_note: Aero Tune Strain DPS; stacks Tune Strain Interfered and Mindlock, then nukes with Heavy Attack and Liberation. Significantly weaker outside Tune Strain teams.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: The premier Aero Tune Strain DPS with SS overall placement, but a high-investment unit that needs Denia, Lynae, and Mornye to shine and struggles in wave-based content. Pull if you run Tune Strain comps; otherwise flexible DPS units are safer.

members.name: Qingxiao
members.note: Aero Tune Strain carry; stacks Mindlock and nukes with Heavy Attack and Liberation.

members.name: Denia
members.note: Tune Strain mode sub-DPS; Tune Break Boost and team damage buffs.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Best Tune Strain support; Off-Tune Buildup Rate, team damage buffs, and healing.

teams.name: Premium: Qingxiao + Denia + Mornye
teams.rotation: Mornye sets up buffs and sustain, Denia runs her Tune Strain loop to funnel ATK and Tune Break Boost, then Qingxiao stacks Tune Strain and detonates with her Heavy Attack and Liberation windows.

members.name: Qingxiao
members.note: Same Aero Tune Strain carry; benefits from Sanhua's fast rotations and Basic Attack DMG buffs.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Fast sub-DPS; strong Basic Attack DMG buffs and quick rotations.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Tune Strain support; Off-Tune Buildup Rate and team damage buffs.

teams.name: Alternative: Qingxiao + Sanhua + Mornye
teams.rotation: Mornye sets up buffs, Sanhua runs a fast buff rotation, then Qingxiao takes the field for her Tune Strain damage window.

tier_badge.label: Meta-defining
tier_badge.note: SS overall, SS in ToA and S+ in WhiWa on the Game8 3.7 tier list; the premier Aero Tune Strain DPS.

sequences.verdict: S0 has the full loop. S2 raises her Mindlock ceiling, stop at S3 for the Liberation Crit spike, S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Full combat loop with the Mindlock debuff game at S0.
Mindlock ceiling rises to 25; hardest hit gets +40%.
Endgame investment; substantial overall damage lift.
